plugins.name: first-prompt-model
plugins.description: Haiku reads the first prompt of a session and picks the main-loop model for the session

plugins.name: harness-dev
plugins.description: Authoring aids for the Claude Code harness — skill shapes (workflow, loop, instruction, router), golden words that stand in for a rule set, pruning an existing skill or doc corpus into the house style, repo bootstrap (README, CLAUDE.md, deploy and adr skills, settings), and agent-work metrics from a per-turn ledger (re-ask ratio and causes, prompts to done, pasted blocks that should be a skill).

plugins.name: hi
plugins.description: Per-session prompt stack: push/pop/list/drop prompts across a session.

plugins.name: line-comment
plugins.description: Review comments on lines of any file, kept outside the file. Zed writes them through the line-comment language server; /line-comment:act reads the store and does the work, /line-comment:write places comments, /line-comment:unresolved reports what is still open, /line-comment:prune throws comments away, /line-comment:distill turns the habits act saved into review rules.

plugins.name: prompt-stack
plugins.description: Push, pop and list prompt drafts in files under ~/.claude/prompt-stack, from a key-opened menu

plugins.name: self-improvement
plugins.description: Scores every Claude Code session for the lessons it holds and proposes where each one belongs in the harness: a watermarked background scan kicked by the SessionStart hook, one haiku call per dirty session, then a suggestion pass over the existing skill inventory. Browsable in the self-improve TUI. High scorers are archived for the capture-lesson skill to turn into skills and the dream skill to consolidate.

plugins.name: smart-commit
plugins.description: Split the working tree of every nearby git repo into logical commits at hunk granularity. A sonnet subagent proposes the split into an editable file, the operator answers each block, a second subagent builds the commits in a throwaway worktree and cherry-picks them back.

plugins.name: wm
plugins.description: Work lifecycle management v2 — phased workflows (research, plan, implement) with agents, commands, and hooks.

plugins.name: zed-clear-guard
plugins.description: Blocks /clear when Claude Code runs in a Zed terminal
